description: This file contains a Unity C# script for managing tilt input on mobile devices, including classes for handling tilt axis options, axis mapping, and custom property drawing in the Unity editor.

classes.name: TiltInput
classes.description: Handles tilt input for mobile devices, mapping device acceleration to virtual axes or mouse positions.

classes.name: TiltInput.AxisMapping
classes.description: Defines how tilt input maps to axes or mouse positions, with a type and axis name.

classes.name: TiltInput.AxisOptions
classes.description: Enumeration for tilt axis options: ForwardAxis or SidewaysAxis.

classes.name: TiltInputAxisStylePropertyDrawer
classes.description: Custom property drawer for AxisMapping in the Unity editor, providing a custom GUI for axis type and name.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Initializes the virtual axis if the mapping type is NamedAxis.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Calculates tilt angle based on device acceleration and updates the virtual axis or mouse position accordingly.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Removes the virtual axis when the component is disabled.

methods.name: OnGUI
methods.description: Draws the custom property GUI for AxisMapping in the Unity editor.
